title: request.
creator: jackinandroidon
content:
I have a request.

Please make it easier to send feedback to the developers.

I don’t want to have to log in to the forum every time just to ask someone who might not even be an expert.

I’m Japanese and don’t speak English, so the English forum is difficult for me to use.

It’s a hassle to have to post on the forum like this just because I can’t easily send feedback in my local language.

I have two pieces of feedback I wanted to share this time.

1. Sometimes when I open Thunderbird, I get an error message saying it can’t load because there are too many accounts. Is this because it’s trying to check them all at once?

Please have it load them one by one in order. Or, please add an option in the settings to do this.

2. Messages marked with “Re:” are replies, right?

Let’s say my account is “Apple.” If I reply from “Apple,” a message marked “Re:” should remain in the “Apple” folder. From the recipient’s perspective, replies to emails from “Apple” should also come from “Apple.”

However, there were emails where I was recorded as having replied from a different account, even though I don’t recall switching accounts when replying.

So, from the recipient’s perspective, it looked like the email came from a stranger, and they replied asking me to identify myself.

While it’s not impossible that I might have changed the address by mistake while half-asleep, I’m reporting that there were instances where I was recorded as replying from a different address even though I don’t remember making a mistake.

I just want to share a request and a report, so there’s no need to reply.

Translated with DeepL.com (free version)

要望です。

開発者にフィードバックを簡単に送れるようにしてください。

いちいちフォーラムへログインして、素人かもしれない人に訊きたい訳ではありません。

私は日本人で英語が出来ませんので、英語のフォーラムも使いにくいです。

簡単にローカル言語でフィードバックが送れないから、こうしてフォーラムで投稿しないといけないのは手間です。

今回送りたかったフィードバックは二つです。

1、サンダーバードを開くと、アカウントが多いからロード出来ないとかエラーメッセージが出てくることが時々ありますが、一度に確認しようとするからでしょう？

一つずつ順番に読み込むようにしてください。 もしくは、設定で、そのように出来るようにしてください。

アカウントがリンゴだとします。 リンゴから返信したら、リンゴの中にRe付きのものが残るはずです。 相手からしたら、リンゴから来たメールの返信もリンゴから来るはずです。

しかし、返信する時にアカウントを変えた覚えがないのに、違うアカウントから返信したことになったメールがありました。

なので、相手からしたら、知らない人からメールが来たことになり、誰だか分からないから教えてくださいと返信が来ました。

ねぼけて返信時にアドレスを変更した可能性も0ではありませんが、間違えた覚えが無いのに違うアドレスから返信したことになったものがあったことを報告しておきます。

title: Persistent Column and Folder Layout Issues — Not Being Saved Between Sessions
creator: technology.feeder
content:
Subject: Persistent Column and Folder Layout Issues — Not Being Saved Between Sessions

This is a follow-up to my previous support requests regarding two ongoing problems that significantly impact daily usability.

Column Settings I manage multiple accounts, and my preferred column layout is: Starred, Read Status, Attachment, Subject, From, and Date/Time. I do not use Threads, Correspondents, or Spam Status columns. Despite setting these preferences repeatedly, Thunderbird fails to retain them. Every day I must spend time reconfiguring columns across some or all of my accounts — the state varies unpredictably from one session to the next. This is a persistent, daily frustration that costs meaningful time. Most other major email clients save and reliably maintain column preferences. I'd expect Thunderbird to do the same.

Folder Panel Layout Two problems occur regularly when Thunderbird loads:

Folder order — Standard system folders (Inbox, Sent, Drafts, All Mail, Trash, Spam) should appear at the top of each account. Instead, Sent, All Mail, Trash, and/or Spam are frequently scattered among custom folders, with no apparent consistency.

Folder expansion — Most or all folders load in an expanded state, exposing every nested sub-folder regardless of whether they contain unread mail. This creates unnecessary visual clutter and requires manual collapsing each session.

Again, this behavior is uncommon in other widely-used email clients. Summary These are not one-time glitches — they recur daily and represent a significant usability gap. I'd appreciate confirmation that these are known issues being tracked, or guidance on a reliable fix. Reformatting the interface every morning is not a reasonable expectation for users.

title: How can I open MSG file in Thunderbird on Windows?
creator: smitholivia0390
content: Opening an MSG file in Thunderbird is a really difficult task because MSG files work only in Outlook. In this situation, accessing MSG files in Thunderbird, you ned to convert MSG files to EML format. Manual Method to Open MSG Files in Thunderbird 1. Open the MSG file in Microsoft Outlook. 2. Go to File > Save As. 3. Save the email as an EML file. 4. Open Thunderbird. 5. Create or select a local folder. 6. Drag and drop the EML file into Thunderbird. 7. Open and read the email there. The above methods are only useful when you have a few MSG files. In case you have hundreds of emails, you need to use a dedicated tool like Softaken MSG to EML Converter. They are designed to convert Outlook MSG files into EML. It also supports multiple MSG files, so you do not need to convert emails one by one. After conversion, save the EML files in a folder, then open them with Thunderbird or drag them into a Thunderbird mail folder. Keep the original MSG files until all emails are checked.

La versión depende, pero son todas 140.10 ó 140.11. La carpeta con el correo no está en el equipo local, sino en una carpeta compartida del servidor de dominio (cada uno tiene la suya) con el fin de hacer las copias de seguridad. El servidor de dominio pasó de Server 2008 a un Server 2025 standard (en este caso en máquina virtual). El antivirus es Eset Endpoint Security y no indica ningún error. Esta configuración ha funcionado bien varios años. Desde hace un tiempo tras alguna actualización ha empezado a ir muy lento y cada vez que arrancamos thunderbird no aparece el inbox y hace la indexación de las carpetas, tardando bastante, mas de media hora incluso (algunos tienen dos o tres cuentas de correo). Una vez indexada, normalmente iba bastante bien siempre que no se cerrase el programa, pues volvía a hacerlo. Desde la semana pasada ha empezado a no funcionar en algunos equipos, al arrancar se queda congelado (no responde) y no hace ni la indexación. En otros casos funciona pero muy lento (minutos para abrir o enviar correos de texto con una pequeña firma). El informático nos indica que puede ser porque el programa está diseñado para trabajar en local y no en red. No ha visto nada raro en las actualizaciones, pero no sé si hay algo en concreto que comprobar o si saben si hay alguna incompatibilidad que provoque estos fallos. ¿podrían ayudarnos por favor?
